cells.gaps: No finance line tied to the framework; no published report against its targets (TZA-011 is activity only); plan states dated targets with no cost. A World Bank March 2023 row (TZA-022) calls the then-current strategy a draft, superseded by the 2024 launch.
cells.note: Digital Economy Strategic Framework 2024-2034, launched by the President on 2024-07-29 with its text on ictc.go.tz, is adopted, public and in period, so stage 3. Stage 4 needs published results against its targets, and reporting is activity only.
